extraction.Name: Charles Moore
extraction.Refused/Protested: Yes I told him that I dont want it at this time as I can not take care of a patent. He did not say anything then but in about a month he sent for me and gave me the patent.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged and sold; my wife now owns one quarter and my daughter the other. I sold it through the Rosebud Agency Office.
extraction.Buyer: C. W. Owen (records show sale to C. W. Owen, but Moore states it was a fraud and they got the land back)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: I mortgaged one quarter and later mortgaged both of them to take care of the first mortgage.
extraction.Occupation/Income: We live on the proceeds of trust funds.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered from the Farmer's office at Okreek; Moore states he did not sign a receipt for the patent. Records show Moore and his wife sold land to C. W. Owen, but Moore states it was a fraud and they got the land back. Mortgaged to Weaver. Paid off mortgages. Wife now owns one quarter and daughter owns the other. Has been supporting about 10 dependents; still seven. Not in good health. Subscribed and sworn before J. S. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32, on May 7, 1929.
